verdict.rationale: Rive documents reusable components whose source changes propagate to instances, but only "throughout your Rive file". The evidence shows no shared library that publishes components or styles across files and projects, and no controlled update or accept-changes flow. Single-file components are an adjacent feature, not this capability.

support.subject: As a designer, shared libraries publish components and styles across files and projects, with controlled updates when the source changes
